name: Pumpradar ReversalV2

changelog.description: RSI mean-reversion with correct 30/70 thresholds. Kept disabled until backtested.

backtest_90d.note: FAILED. Pure mean-reversion fires too often in trending markets. Low win-rate (29.6%) and sub-1 PF. Kept disabled. Needs a trend-filter gate before re-testing.

changelog.description: EMA gate experiment: added ema_trend=0.5, rsi_position=1.5, bb_position=1.5, CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD=65. REVERTED — results were dramatically worse. Lower threshold opened more bad trades (186→227 trades, -11.78%→-16.44%). Root cause: lowered threshold negated EMA gate filtering. Config restored to v0.1 weights.

backtest_90d.note: FAILED. Adding ema_trend=0.5 with lower threshold opened more marginal trades. EMA weight boosts confidence on both sides, not a hard gate. Reverted to v0.1 config. Next step: raise CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD to 75+ or use EMA as hard filter in signal logic.

changelog.description: Add BTC_TREND_WEIGHTS: Uptrend 1.0 — mean-reversion strategies don't depend on BTC direction, remove the 0.8 penalty during bull markets

description: True mean-reversion: buy RSI<30 oversold, sell RSI>70 overbought. BB confirms. DISABLED — both v0.1 and v0.2 (EMA gate experiment) showed negative returns. Needs hard EMA filter in signal logic, not just weight adjustment.
